summary: The crew has arrived in the Matrix outside the Hotel Lafayette. The door opens and Neo steps back out into the Matrix for the first time since his release, squinting at a sun that seems unnaturally bright; he is the only one without sunglasses. Apoc and Switch stay at the door while the others move into the alley. Morpheus says they should be back in an hour. Cypher opens the driver's door of an old car as Trinity, Morpheus and Neo cross toward it; Cypher glances about quickly and drops something inside a garbage can. It is revealed to be a cellular phone, its blue display showing as the line connects.

what_changes.before: Still inside the real world / not yet returned to the Matrix
what_changes.after: Physically back in the Matrix for the first time since his release
what_changes.evidence: for the first time since his release, Neo steps back into the Matrix.  He squints at the sun which seems unnaturally bright.

what_changes.before: Appears to be simply preparing to drive the crew away
what_changes.after: Secretly discards a phone and lets a call connect, hinting at a hidden agenda
what_changes.evidence: Cypher glances about quickly, then drops something inside a garbage can. It is a cellular phone and we see its blue display as the line connects.

event_hint.one_line: The crew arrives in the Matrix to begin the mission to reach the Oracle.

uncertain: Whether the dropped phone is Cypher's own or something meant to be hidden from the others
